guides.title: Docker & containers
guides.description: Install Docker, run Compose stacks and compare container runtimes.
guides.intro: Everything needed to run containers on a VPS: installing Docker Engine from the official repository, wiring up Compose, and choosing between Docker and Podman.

guides.title: Web servers & stacks
guides.description: Nginx, Apache, LAMP, LEMP, PHP-FPM, TLS certificates and server comparisons.
guides.intro: Pick a web server, install a full stack and put a valid TLS certificate in front of it. Includes the honest comparisons: Nginx versus Apache, LiteSpeed versus Caddy.

guides.title: Minecraft servers
guides.description: Vanilla Java server setup for 1.8.8 through 1.21 on Debian/Ubuntu and RHEL-family systems.
guides.intro: Version-specific guides for running a Minecraft Java server: JVM setup, systemd services, firewall ports and the download links for each release.

guides.title: Server security
guides.description: SSH hardening, fail2ban, firewalls, sudo users and brute-force protection.
guides.intro: The baseline every fresh server needs: a non-root sudo user, key-only SSH, a host firewall and fail2ban. Do these before opening anything to the internet.

guides.title: Monitoring & operations
guides.description: Resource monitoring with htop, Netdata and Uptime Kuma.
guides.intro: Know what your server is doing before your users tell you. Lightweight CLI checks, long-term metrics with Netdata, and uptime alerts with Uptime Kuma.

guides.title: VPN & private networking
guides.description: WireGuard setup and a WireGuard vs OpenVPN comparison.
guides.intro: Run your own VPN or connect servers into a private network. WireGuard is the default choice for most workloads: fewer lines of configuration and better throughput.

guides.title: Self-hosted apps
guides.description: Nextcloud, WordPress, Portainer, Nginx Proxy Manager, TeamSpeak and more.
guides.intro: Deploy the applications people actually run on a VPS: a private cloud, a WordPress site, a container dashboard, a reverse proxy and a voice server.

guides.title: System administration
guides.description: System updates, package mirrors, file transfer, runtimes and GPU drivers.
guides.intro: The routine work that keeps a server healthy: patching the OS, picking a fast package mirror, moving files safely and installing runtimes or drivers.
